Tests that streaming requests bypass cache entirely

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
client = LiterLlm.create_client_from_json('{"api_key":"your-api-key","cache":{"backend":"memory","max_entries":256,"ttl_seconds":300}}')
result = client.chat_stream(LiterLlm::ChatCompletionRequest.new(messages: [{ 'content' => 'Hello', 'role' => 'user' }], model: 'gpt-4')).to_a
puts result.inspect
```
